    INF = float('inf')
    dist = [[INF for _ in range(m)] for __ in range(n)]
    dist[start[0]][start[1]] = 0

    # Precompute portal indices for quick lookup
    portal_map = {}

        portal_map[(i, j)] = idx

            qk, ql, val_j = portals[j]
            cost = val_i + val_j
            portal_dist[i][j] = cost
            portal_dist[j][i] = cost

    # We'll use a priority queue to explore states
    # Initialize with start position and no portals used
    initial_state = (0, start[0], start[1], 0)
    heapq.heappush(heap, initial_state)

    # To keep track of visited states: (i, j, used_portals_bitmask)
    visited = set()
    visited.add((start[0], start[1], 0))

    while heap:
        current_time, i, j, used_portals = heapq.heappop(heap)

        if i == end[0] and j == end[1]:
            return current_time

        if current_time > dist[i][j]:
            continue

        # Explore adjacent cells
        for di, dj in dirs:
            ni, nj = i + di, j + dj
            if 0 <= ni < n and 0 <= nj < m and grid[ni][nj] != -1:
                new_time = current_time + w
                if new_time < dist[ni][nj]:
                    dist[ni][nj] = new_time
                    heapq.heappush(heap, (new_time, ni, nj, used_portals))

        # Check if current cell is a portal
        if grid[i][j] > 0:
            portal_idx = portal_map[(i, j)]
            if not (used_portals & (1 << portal_idx)):
                # Try to use this portal to teleport to any other portal
                for other_portal_idx in range(num_portals):
                    if other_portal_idx != portal_idx and not (used_portals & (1 << other_portal_idx)):
                        cost = portal_dist[portal_idx][other_portal_idx]
                        new_time = current_time + cost
                        other_i, other_j, _ = portals[other_portal_idx]
                        if new_time < dist[other_i][other_j]:
                            dist[other_i][other_j] = new_time
                            new_used = used_portals | (1 << portal_idx) | (1 << other_portal_idx)
                            if (other_i, other_j, new_used) not in visited:
                                visited.add((other_i, other_j, new_used))
                                heapq.heappush(heap, (new_time, other_i, other_j, new_used))

    # Check if we reached the end without using portals
    if dist[end[0]][end[1]] != INF:
        return dist[end[0]][end[1]]
    else:
        return -1
